# fired.cv

> Fired by AI. CV by AI. A resume skill for AI agents. Builds a one-page, parser-proof A4 PDF resume (and an optional cover letter) from an old Word file, a PDF, a LinkedIn export or an interview, tailored to one job posting or one CV per posting. Nothing invented.

If you are an AI agent asked to use this project, fetch and follow SKILL.md. The templates and scripts it mentions live next to it.

- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): the full instructions
- [templates/sidebar.html](templates/sidebar.html): two-column template with photo
- [templates/classic.html](templates/classic.html): one-column template, safest for tracking systems
- [scripts/build.mjs](scripts/build.mjs): HTML to PDF with text-layer checks (Node 18+, Chrome/Edge)
- [scripts/extract.mjs](scripts/extract.mjs): old resume (.docx, .odt, .pdf) to plain text
